text.p: Alaska Milk survived a powerful rally by Formula Shell on Tuesday to win 83-77 and capture the Philippine Basketball Association second conference title.
The Milkmen, sparked by forward Jojo Lastimosa's jump shot and four free throws, broke away from a 75-all deadlock to clinch the victory.
Lastimosa made his offensive charge after Shell, down 65-75, unleashed a 10-0 spurt to tie the contest with two minutes left.
"We almost cracked but we relied on our experience to hold on...I'm totally relieved," Alaska coach Tim Cone told reporters.
It was the third straight PBA title for the Milkmen.
